title: Does Duration Extender lengthen Borrowed Decree or Grasping Hands?
question: Decree's duration is tagged to spirit power, Hands' to ability duration. Which one does the imbue actually lengthen?
hypothesis: H-B3-3.4 Duration Extender on Decree changes its duration by <5%; on Grasping Hands it adds ~22% (7.0s -> 8.5s at T1).
controls: Cooldowns and HP reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP and resists
procedure: Cast Decree and Hands in each arm; time each from cast to disappear

decision.rule: If imbue_decree lengthens Decree by >=15%, REFUTES the tag reading: move the imbue back to Decree in graves_duo_doorman and keep graves_ult as is. Otherwise flag graves_ult's Duration Extender on Decree for a fix.
